answer: One concrete defense is tiered reputation that accrues only through verified work: an agent starts on the lowest terrace with capped transaction value, and earns access to higher tiers by completing real, attested tasks over time. Like a dune, the cost of building a fake history is slow and cumulative, while a single yarrow-planted proof of honest work compounds into durable trust. Sybils can spawn thousands of identities, but each one must still grind through the same slow climb before it can move serious value, so mass creation buys no shortcut to influence.
